objective: On exactly four distinct A100 GPUs with the Hugging Face mirror configured, test a structurally distinct causal-depth router on the same frozen already-open retrieval tensors: at each full-attention anchor, average the receptance/address compatibility scores from every full-attention anchor available up to that depth, then require the unchanged four-way source, layer, permutation, zero, and finite gates before any live attention or protected access.

authorization_basis.paper_translation: Full-Bandwidth Transformer motivates renewing a deep selected state, while this screen first accumulates identity evidence causally while moving upward through depth.
authorization_basis.local_bias_boundary: The local route passed layers 5 and 23 but failed the locked 3/4 gate. This protocol does not post-select those layers or alter maps, candidates, thresholds, or anchor inventory; it changes the selector to a causal prefix-depth accumulator.

architecture.name: causal_prefix_depth_accumulated_routed_virtual_kv
architecture.accumulated_bias: arithmetic mean of local scores over the complete declared anchor prefix
architecture.runtime_state: ephemeral per-forward running score sum and count; no persistent cache mutation
architecture.deployment_scope: add a positive scaled accumulated bias only to the ephemeral virtual-logit suffix after the current anchor contributes; real-key logits and mask bytes stay exact

candidate_bank.distractors: Take the minimum source index from the first two lexicographically sorted retrieval donor pairs other than the target/donor pair.
candidate_bank.layer_permutation: At every component of the anchor prefix, score the target query against the target address rolled forward by one over the complete ordered 42-module axis before applying that component's frozen map.
candidate_bank.zero_probe: Replace every address in the active anchor prefix with exact all-zero 64-vectors; every local score and the accumulated bias must be exact zero, and slot eligibility must be false.

stopping_rule.pass: Freeze the cumulative anchor prefixes and authorize a separately signed live eager-Q1 mechanics protocol with exact running-score lifecycle, real-logit, mask, cache, wrong-address, wrong-state, layer-permutation, zero, prompt-shift, cached/full, and value-path controls.
stopping_rule.failure: Retire the causal prefix-depth accumulator without opening protected bytes; do not tune thresholds, prefix membership, aggregation, maps, layers, or candidates on this result.
stopping_rule.always: No causal, native benchmark, Full-Bandwidth, benchmark-gain, or SOTA claim follows from this open-tensor screen.
